optical_root_lower_reverse_check.qualitative_facts: RadialProfileGeometry requires nonzero w second derivative at each root. CanonicalGeometry boundary requires actual smooth chart/height and nonzero Jacobian at each closed-piece point. These give local/componentwise nondegeneracy, not a displayed common material inverse bound.
optical_root_lower_reverse_check.quantitative_facts: RadialReturnMargins is a Diophantine lower bound for integrated optical travel. Its current consequence selects an interior collar. N01 tame towers control coefficient/flow differences from the reference; at the reference their order-zero values vanish, so that projection alone does not control an absolute root inverse. Higher variations and the full radial inverse hypotheses have not been ruled out as a route.
optical_root_lower_reverse_check.N04b_vs_N04c: N04PartA/B contain actual geometry and exact Airy/cubic identities, but no material norm bound on chart/height/inverse derivatives. N04Properties potential/divided estimates and CanonicalPrimitiveGeometry materialJets occur in the later target, so using them to prove the target would be circular.
optical_root_lower_reverse_check.limit: No counterexample satisfying the complete current Through03/IsRadialReference/N04b predicates was constructed or claimed. No statement-repair claim follows from this audit.
